title: Trust Center - Security and Legal information from Octopus Deploy - Octopus Deploy
markdown:
[Trust Center](https://trust.octopus.com/)

## Enterprise compliant

We undergo regular third-party audits and technical assessments of our data security to ensure privacy and safety. Our security credentials include:

- ISO 27001:2022 ( [Download our ISO 270001 certificate](https://i.octopus.com/trust/Octopus+Deploy+-+ISO+27001+Certificate+Oct-2024.pdf) [)](https://a.storyblok.com/f/92909/x/e84d2016ca/octopus-deploy-iso-27001-certificate-signed.pdf)
- SOC 2 Type II ( [View or request access to our SOC 2 Type II confirmation](https://trust.octopus.com/resources))
- SOC 3 report ( [View or request access to our SOC 3 report](https://trust.octopus.com/resources))

We also provide a [CSA Consensus Assessment Initiative Questionnaire (CAIQ) lite](https://octopus.com/docs/security/caiq), which is a convenient, standards-based, mechanism for aligning different compliance frameworks with our own.

We comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements in relation to handling personal data such as GDPR and CCPA. See our [Privacy Policy](https://octopus.com/legal/privacy) and our [GDPR disclosures](https://octopus.com/legal/gdpr) for more information, or refer to our [Data Processing Agreement](https://i.octopus.com/trust/Octopus+Deploy+Customer+Agreement+(Complete)+1+October+2024.pdf#page=21).

[Email our compliance team](mailto:compliance@octopus.com) for more information about our commitment to the above standards.

## Proactive platform security

We perform ongoing security testing, including:

- Vulnerability scanning
- Penetration testing
- External testing via our Bugcrowd bug bounty program

Every year Octopus undergoes a security review conducted by a third-party company. Request access to our [penetration test report](https://trust.octopus.com/) to find out more.

We also tell you about problems as soon as we know about them, with real-time [status updates](https://status.octopus.com/).

See our [trust report](https://trust.octopus.com/) for a comprehensive, real-time look at our security controls, policies, and compliance reports.

## Security operations

Our Security Operations, Product, Engineering, IT Operations & Compliance teams, build security into all our processes.

Our secure, industry-standard development practices help prevent security threats.

![Soc 2 certification logo](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x200/7ddf0d5cc8/2-1-1-soc-2-t2-logo-circle-colour-1.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))![SOC3 icon](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/533x533/7c7763ea6f/soc3-new.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))![ISO 27001 badge](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x200/70d4e77203/iso-iec-new.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))![White GDRP text on a blue circle with 12 yellow stars](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/200x200/2b4ba147e0/gdpr-new.svg)

##### Data encryption

We already encrypt data we believe is sensitive, but you can encrypt any variables you want to protect.

##### Secure comms

Octopus communicates with deployment targets using transport encryption and tamper-proofing techniques.

##### Simpler auditing

Create a culture of team trust and accountability. Every action is traceable in Octopus's extensive audit logs.

##### Access control

Set controls for different teams in your organization with single-sign-on (SSO) and role-based access control (RBAC).

![Octopus audit UI screen](https://a.storyblok.com/f/185929/1083x717/232b8f768a/audit-ui-screen.png/m/fit-in/1200x0/filters:quality(85):format(webp))

## Security admin controls

Verify team members and control who can do what in Octopus.

The tools include:

- Identity and access control
- HTTP security controls
- Single sign-on (SSO)
- IT service management (ITSM) integrations for enterprise customers

[Learn more about product security](https://octopus.com/docs/security)

Alongside built-in account management and Octopus ID, we support major authentication providers out-of-box.

- Username and password
- Active Directory authentication
- Azure Active Directory authentication
- GoogleApps authentication
- LDAP authentication
- Okta authentication
- Guest login

[Learn more about authentication providers](https://octopus.com/docs/security/authentication)

> As we scale, we still need the same kind of auditable, access-controlled environments that we had, but with added complexity. Octopus provides the familiarity and flexibility that we need to grow, along with meeting our security requirements. No other tool we looked at really offered the level of control over security and auditing that Octopus does out of the box.

### Customer agreement

Our [customer agreement](https://octopus.com/legal/customer-agreement), signed by over 20,000 companies, governs the use of Octopus Deploy. Please note that we have separate product terms regarding [Octopus Server](https://i.octopus.com/trust/octopus-customer-agreement-2025-v2.pdf#page=14), [Octopus Cloud](https://i.octopus.com/trust/octopus-customer-agreement-2025-v2.pdf#page=15), [premium support terms](https://i.octopus.com/trust/octopus-customer-agreement-2025-v2.pdf#page=22), and [TAM services terms](https://i.octopus.com/trust/octopus-customer-agreement-2025-v2.pdf#page=21).

We don't negotiate on our customer agreement. It allows us to standardize and keep our costs down.

### Privacy policy

We strongly believe in privacy. Octopus complies with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

[Read our privacy policy](https://octopus.com/legal/privacy) to understand what data we collect and how we use it.

### Octopus Cloud acceptable use policy

We want you to have the best possible experience with Octopus Cloud, but without affecting--or getting affected by--others.

Our [acceptable use policy](https://octopus.com/legal/acceptable-usage) outlines how you should use Octopus Cloud and how you shouldn't.

### Social responsibility statement

To help us uphold [our values](https://handbook.octopus.com/getting-oriented/values), it’s important we conduct our business in an honest, responsible, and ethical way. This [social responsibility statement](https://i.octopus.com/trust/Octopus+Deploy+Social+Responsibility+Statement.pdf) helps us be transparent about our efforts to maintain our values.

### For more information

[Email us](mailto:support@octopus.com) for more information about our security credentials and the security features of our product.
